pages.title: About Us
pages.content:
We are a dedicated community of fly-fishing enthusiasts with access to fishing on the River Cam upstream of the historic city of Cambridge. The club has a long history and offers its members a rare opportunity to fish for wild brown trout in the Essex/Cambridgeshire borders. We are first and foremost fly fishers, but we are also guided by principles of conservation and sustainability, and are committed to protecting our rivers so that they remain a source of joy for years to come. Our Values
  • Sustainability: Protecting the River Cam and maintaining it as a legacy for future generations
  • Community: Supporting and mentoring fellow anglers within the club
  • Enjoyment: Ensuring that our local river is a source of tranquillity and pleasure for our members
